limitations.note: The combinational decode fixes the one-cycle output delay but drops explicit reset gating, so asserting reset cannot clear the outputs until the state register updates and triggers the decode.
The reset check waits for the state register and output decode to settle, so it cannot distinguish direct reset gating from outputs that clear only through the state update.
